## About the Data

The data used in this project comes from official 2024 Major League Baseball roster information and player physical profiles, cross-referenced with historical statistics from the [Sean Lahman Baseball Database](https://www.seanlahman.com/baseball-archive/statistics/). The dataset tracks biometric measurements—including height in inches, weight in pounds, primary fielding position, batting side, and pitching hand—across active players on 30 Major League teams during the 2024 season.
